 “I was really proud of our team’s response to our game the other night. I thought they really took it to heart. They fixed their offensive spacing. They finished really well. Overall, I was really, really impressed with what they did on the floor tonight.”

 This game is one that they will have more of a challenge, as the team that they will be playing will have the home-court advantage, something that the Blue Raiders didn't have. This game against the Bruins serves as just the second game that the Lady Vols have played on the road, following the game between the Lady Vols and the Coppin State Eagles.
--> This game is one that they will have more of a challenge, as the team that they will be playing will have the home-court advantage, something that the Blue Raiders didn't have. This game against the Bruins serves as just the second game that the Lady Vols have played on the road, following the game between the Lady Vols and the Coppin State Eagles.
 This is still a game that the Lady Vols are projected to win, while the Bruins search for their second win of the season, holding a 1-3 record. Their lone win this season was against the Troy Trojans, which is a team that doesn't compare to Caldwell's Lady Vols. If the Lady Vols were to fall short in this game, then this would be a generationally bad loss for a team that has a ton of promise, and some have even expected them to find themselves in the top 25.
